title: Zechariah — Instructions and Commands
content:
Zechariah — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

30 additional passage records · 36 quoted verse units. Read Zechariah in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Worship, prayer and holy things · Justice, truth and protection · Mercy, neighbors and the vulnerable · Family, marriage and household · Historical commissions, journeys and public life

Justice, truth and protection

Everlasting · 1 passage records

Zechariah 8:16

Record type: Continuing moral instruction. Source section: Let Your Hands Be Strong.

Zechariah 8:16 — These are the things you shall do: speak truth, each to his neighbor, and render peaceful judgment in your gates.

Context and scope: Paul repeats speaking truth to one’s neighbor. The Everlasting assessment applies to truthful speech; the city-gate judicial setting is not imposed on every reader.

New Testament comparison: Ephesians 4:25.
